question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
WITH ent_styles AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, 
           MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_style
    FROM (
        SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) as rnk
        FROM Entertainer_Styles
    )
    WHERE rnk <= 2
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
),
cust_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, 
           MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerID, StyleID, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) as rnk
        FROM Musical_Preferences
    )
    WHERE rnk <= 2
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM ent_styles es
JOIN cust_prefs cp ON (cp.first_pref = es.first_style AND cp.second_pref = es.second_style)
                  OR (cp.first_pref = es.second_style AND cp.second_pref = es.first_style)
JOIN Entertainers e ON es.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON cp.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
